metadata.description: Reusable plugins for coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, and Agent Plugins-compatible hosts) by 3dgiordano.

plugins.name: executive-self-monitoring
plugins.description: Plan-anchored drift self-check: shared skill + per-host cadence hook, installable as one unit.

plugins.name: epistemic-self-monitoring
plugins.description: Observation-vs-conjecture discipline: claims carry their evidence and a named falsifier; only verified claims become facts or closures. Shared skill + per-host hooks.

plugins.name: persistence-self-monitoring
plugins.description: Persist-or-quit signal: counts repeated attempts on the same file, command or error and effort since the user last spoke, and nudges only when a threshold is crossed. Shared skill + per-host hooks. Never blocks.
